correctness.rationale: For GP(8,3), r=2 independence permits isolated vertices/isolated edges but forbids every induced connected component of order at least three. Since the graph is cubic and triangle-free, the minimal forbidden faces are exactly 48 triples consisting of a vertex and two neighbors. Independently generated those triples from the actual 24 graph edges and enumerated all 65,535 nonempty vertex masks, obtaining exactly 6812 faces and f=(16,120,512,1324,2064,1840,816,120), in agreement with the separate original-checker component traversal. Independently executed the stated 16-vertex pivot matching: 3404 disjoint face/coface pairs and only four critical masks [8192,33637,33644,49964], of dimensions 0,6,6,6. Independently constructed all 35,104 nonempty Hasse cover incidences, reversed matched covers, and completely topologically sorted the 6812-face graph; no cycles exist. Forman gives a CW model with one 0-cell and three 6-cells; its attaching maps target a point, hence integral wedge ∨³S⁶. The mod-two Betti crosscheck alone would NOT imply this homotopy type; exhaustive acyclicity is essential.

originality.rationale: Published Resultary RESULT.md on the same exact GP(8,3) computes ORDINARY independence Ind_1(G) ≃ (∨⁴S³)∨S⁴ and its incidence-graph Alexander-dual proof. The assigned Ind_2(G) allows edges and forbids 3-vertex connected components; it has 6812 faces versus 1090 for Ind_1 and a different homotopy type. Published graph-family theorems for complete multipartite, cycles, trees and whiskered graphs do not specialize to this cubic girth-six graph. Another Resultary result on the same graph is total three-cut, a different complex. The finite exact 2-independence homotopy conclusion is not an automatic consequence of prior r=1 or cut computations.

value.rationale: Higher-independence complexes form a natural vertex-subset filtration of a graph. This complete integral 2-independence classification for a canonical symmetric cubic graph identifies precisely where permitting isolated edges changes the homotopy dimensions relative to the already-known ordinary complex. A minimal four-cell Morse model is substantive finite topology, rather than a generic renaming or a face-count recomputation.
